newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures higher in tandem with Bunds.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures higher in tandem with Bunds.

text.p: 0750 GMT - 10-yr bond futures extend gains after weak start. Rise seen as carryover from favorable US PPI figures Friday suggesting low inflation. Hopes of compromise deal on stability pact at Amsterdam summit also support market.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.59 pct vs 5.60. Bund spread -8 bp vs -9
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.57, up 1 bp
